title: Analysis code for the ESCC endothelial-state manuscript (BMC Genomics submission)
description: Reproducibility code for the ESCC endothelial-state manuscript. Code licence: MIT. v1.1.0 adds TMM+voom pseudobulk sensitivity, nested cross-validation with inner-loop feature re-selection, and GO enrichment using a tested-gene universe (Supplementary Table S16).
